items.title: Neapolitan pizza at Trappica
items.author: Bex Walton
items.note: Photo by Bex Walton, CC BY 2.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/). Rectified to a top-down view; the leopard-spotted crust ring is the pizza base (raw state re-toned to pale dough), six melted mozzarella patches and four basil leaves cut out of it (baked basil = the same leaves wilted).

items.title: Pizza marinara (Napoli)

items.note: The sauce inside the crust ring, rectified, garlic and basil cloned out.

items.title: Mozzarella
items.author: Dezidor
items.note: Photo by Dezidor, CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Six torn chunks cut out of the mozzarella balls, given soft rounded shading.

items.note: Five slices cut out; baked = tamed highlights and a charred rim, raw = the same slices without the oil shine.
